description: This file defines the ProductReviewEntity class, representing product review data within the application. It includes fields such as description, productId, date, and rating, with validation constraints. The class extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable.

classes.name: ProductReviewEntity
classes.description: Entity class representing a product review, with fields for description, product ID, date, and rating, including validation constraints.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the product review.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the product review.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product being reviewed.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID associated with this review.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the review.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the review.
